preconditions.description: The number of test cases T is between 1 and 10^4 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(2 <= N <= 2 * 10**5 for N in [int(input().split()[0]) for _ in range(T)])
preconditions.description: For each test case, the number of vertices N is between 2 and 2 * 10^5 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(len(edges) == N - 1 for N, edges in [(int(input().split()[0]), [tuple(map(int, input().split())) for _ in range(int(input().split()[0]) - 1)]) for _ in range(T)])
preconditions.description: Each test case has exactly N-1 edges.

preconditions.expression: all(all(1 <= u <= N and 1 <= v <= N for u, v in edges) for N, edges in [(int(input().split()[0]), [tuple(map(int, input().split())) for _ in range(int(input().split()[0]) - 1)]) for _ in range(T)])
preconditions.description: Each edge in a test case connects two vertices between 1 and N inclusive.

preconditions.expression: sum(N for N, _ in [(int(input().split()[0]), [tuple(map(int, input().split())) for _ in range(int(input().split()[0]) - 1)]) for _ in range(T)]) <= 2 * 10**5
preconditions.description: The sum of N over all test cases does not exceed 2 * 10^5.

postconditions.expression: all(isinstance(result, int) and 0 <= result <= N - 1 for result, N in zip(return_value, [int(input().split()[0]) for _ in range(T)]))
postconditions.description: For each test case, the output is an integer between 0 and N-1 inclusive, representing the minimum number of edges to add.
